summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted with a four-day history of nausea, vomiting, and abdominal pain, during which she stopped her insulin therapy, leading to severe hyperglycemia and mild diabetic ketoacidosis. IV insulin rapidly corrected her anion gap, and her symptoms improved with supportive care. She was restarted on her home regimen of 60 units of Lantus at bedtime and her usual Humalog sliding scale, with continuation of oral hydromorphone for pain and omeprazole for gastric protection. Her condition stabilized within hours, and after coordination with her primary care provider, she was discharged home with instructions to follow up in two days. No medication changes were made, and she demonstrated understanding of her insulin management. The port in her chest was de-accessed due to poor function and will require outpatient evaluation.
problems: Diabetes with ketoacidosis, type I [juvenile type], uncontrolled
